Rugby League Coach Discusses Player Selection and Rule Changes

Australian Rugby League coach Brad Fittler, known as Freddy, has addressed player selection issues and potential rule changes within the sport. He commented on the "Reynolds saga," which involved player selection decisions, and discussed trials for rule changes. Fittler's remarks came amidst discussions about player performances and team strategies.
